matches.rationale: No report finding covers the missing 128-byte account storage overhead in MIN_DEPOSIT_LAMPORTS.
No report finding says the PDA bump is passed in as a user-supplied argument.
Finding 6 only gives generic advice to validate receiver_ and message_. No finding says MessageSent emits the Ethereum chain id instead of the Eclipse chain id.
Finding 14 criticizes unstructured msg! logging and a hard-coded chain_id. It does not mention the 10 KB log truncation.
Finding 7 names the 64-bit nonce, the risk of collision, and the missing already-used check in sendMessage.
No report finding says addressArrayInitialized accepts an empty array.
Finding 3 is about deposits not being verified against Ethereum events. It does not identify the relayer custody of all bridged funds as the single point of failure.
No report finding mentions the missing _disableInitializers calls in the implementation constructors.
No report finding says invoke_signed is used where plain invoke would do.
Finding 16 flags the fixed 1024-byte Configuration and WithdrawalReceipt allocations as wasting rent.
